title: finding (QA harness): `nav-surfaces-render`'s one red assertion is the test's own timing race — poll `boundingBox` until non-null instead of a fixed 1500 ms wait
body:
Not a product defect. This is a fix to the checklist item under `docs/qa/platform-checklist/`, filed so the harness stops manufacturing a red that costs a triage cycle every run.

## Symptom

`nav-surfaces-render` scores 30/31 pinned surfaces green with **one** red chart assertion. The red was **disproven as a product defect** and traced to the suite's own measurement window:

- 3 fresh loads each rendered **5 real charts** — the product renders correctly every time.
- Polling `boundingBox` every 400 ms returned **null only at t = 1.5 s**, and **non-null for all 19 later samples**.
- t = 1.5 s is exactly where the suite measures, and exactly the recharts `ResponsiveContainer` initial-layout window.
- The same test re-run in isolation is **4/4 green**.

So the item reports a failing surface whenever the fixed wait happens to land inside the layout window — a coin-flip red on a correct product.

## Root cause

The assertion waits a **fixed 1500 ms** and then reads `boundingBox` once. `ResponsiveContainer` has not committed its layout at that instant, so the box is null and the assertion fails. Nothing about the product is involved: the chart is present and measures non-null from the next sample onward.

## Fix

Poll `boundingBox` until it is non-null (with a bounded timeout) instead of waiting a fixed 1500 ms and reading once. The change lands in the checklist/harness under `docs/qa/platform-checklist/` — no product code.

This is the same de-flaking shape as the recently merged objectstack-ai/objectstack#7472 ("bracket case 2's negative assertion instead of waiting 4s") and #7409 ("derive the dot-root watcher waits from the case budget instead of a fixed 20s race"); follow whichever polling helper those settled on rather than adding a third spelling.

## Reproduction

1. Run the `nav-surfaces-render` checklist item as part of the full `platform-core` area — 30/31, with the chart `boundingBox` assertion red.
2. Re-run the same item in isolation — 4/4 green.
3. On a fresh load, poll `boundingBox` every 400 ms: null at t = 1.5 s, non-null on all 19 subsequent samples; 5 real charts render on each of 3 fresh loads.

## Source

Extracted from the QA run objectstack-ai/objectstack#7514 (framework a86db175, console 09987b68).
